title: HSK1 Gate 4 · Eastern Zhou
explanationEn: Gate 4: Eastern Zhou. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第4关：东周。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 两千多年以前，中国有一位老师，叫孔子。孔子是一位好老师。他有很多学生。他的学生有的大，有的小。
passageEn: More than two thousand years ago there was a teacher in China called Confucius. Confucius was a good teacher. He had many students. Some of his students were older, some younger.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than two thousand years ago there was a teacher in China called Confucius.
comprehension.answer: 两千多年以前，中国有一位老师，叫孔子。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 两 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“两”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 两 (liǎng) means "two" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “两”（liǎng）的意思是“two”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 千 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“千”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 千 (qiān) means "thousand" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “千”（qiān）的意思是“thousand”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 两千多年以前，中国有一位老师，叫孔子。

options.text: The water was very big; many people had no home.
More than two thousand years ago there was a teacher in China called Confucius.
Long ago, the waters of China were very high.

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Eastern Zhou in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说东周。
